gcp_config.description: Configuration properties for a Kafka cluster deployed to Google Cloud Platform.
gcp_config.rationale: Defines networking and encryption aspects that directly affect cluster confidentiality and access controls.

access_config.description: The configuration of access to the Kafka cluster.
access_config.rationale: Improper access can expose internal systems.

kms_key.description: The Cloud KMS Key name to use for encryption.
non-compliant: KMS not used or wrongly scoped

capacity_config.description: A capacity configuration of a Kafka cluster.
capacity_config.rationale: Insufficient capacity may lead to instability and service denial.

vcpu_count.description: The number of vCPUs to provision for the cluster. The minimum is 3.
vcpu_count.rationale: Low vCPU count may affect availability under load.

memory_bytes.description: The memory to provision for the cluster in bytes (1 GiB to 8 GiB per vCPU).
memory_bytes.rationale: Too little or too much memory allocation can destabilize workloads.

tls_config.description: TLS configuration for the Kafka cluster. This is used to configure mTLS authentication.
tls_config.rationale: Protects Kafka clients and brokers with encryption and identity validation.

trust_config.description: The configuration of the broker truststore.

ssl_principal_mapping_rules.description: Rules for mapping mTLS certificate DNs to principal names for Kafka ACLs.
ssl_principal_mapping_rules.rationale: Weak or default rules may allow identity spoofing.

network_configs.description: Defines the subnets where the Kafka cluster is accessible.
network_configs.rationale: Improper subnet configuration can expose cluster externally.

subnet.rationale: Subnets influence traffic routing and access visibility.
